faqs.question: Will these Hair Gummies help in new hair growth?
faqs.answer: Biotin Hair Gummies (hair supplements) will help you improve hair strength in 3 months & improve overall hair health with continued usage beyond that. These gummies alone will not help with new hair regrowth. For that we recommend pairing the Hair Gummies with our Hair Growth Serum Roll On, containing 3% Rosemary and 3% Redensyl.

faqs.question: Will these Hair Gummies help reduce severe hair fall?
faqs.answer: These gummies will help manage Stage 1 Hair damage in 3 months &  support hair strength with continued usage. For severe hair fall & hair thinning, you should pair these hair gummies with our Hair Growth Serum.

faqs.question: What is Biotin? Why is it helpful?
faqs.answer: Our hair is made of a protein called Keratin. Having sufficient keratin is important to keep the hair healthy and strong. Biotin (B7) helps in keratin synthesis. It's a vital supplement for hair damage treatment. Biotin and Multivitamins are also gelatin free.

faqs.question: How long should I have these Hair Gummies?
faqs.answer: Hair Gummies are essential hair vitamins that help achieve healthy and strong hair. To manage hair strength, have gummies as a mandatory 3 months course. However, we recommend continuing to eat Hair Gummies for benefits like improved texture, prevention against reduced hair strength.

faqs.question: Are these gummies safe to eat?
faqs.answer: Yes, Hair gummies are 100% safe to eat! They have no preservatives and no artificial colour. They are also Vegetarian, Gluten Free and Gelatin Free.

faqs.question: Is it safe for pregnant women?
faqs.answer: Pregnant women should not use these supplements without consulting a doctor first.

faqs.question: Can a person with diabetes use it?
faqs.answer: Our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free. It is absolutely safe for people with diabetes to consume. However, it is advisable to speak to an expert first.

faqs.question: Can we use this post-pregnancy?
faqs.answer: No, for breastfeeding mothers, we recommend using our post-pregnancy hair gummies, designed specifically for postpartum hair fall. Please click the link in description.

faqs.question: Can it be taken along with other supplements or gummies?
faqs.answer: Yes, our gummies can be consumed along with other gummies and any other supplements you are taking.

faqs.question: Is it really sugar free?
faqs.answer: Yes, our gummies are made from chicory root extract, which makes it completely sugar-free.

faqs.question: Are there any side-effects?
faqs.answer: There are no side-effects. But it is recommended to visit your doctor to check for allergies prior to usage.

faqs.question: Can a person below 18 years of age take this?
faqs.answer: This product is recommended only for women above 18 years of age.
